lab_name: Agentic MSP Support Agent Guided Lab
prepared_by: Amit Kumar (prepared with the CloudLabs Lab Builder)

phases.phase: Research and solution design (Foundry agents, Entra Agent ID, OAuth identity passthrough, API Management, Container Apps, Dataverse impersonation and security, Purview, Key Vault, pricing)
phases.assumptions: Microsoft Learn research notes with sources for every exercise area; region, model, tier and security decisions recorded in BUILD-NOTES.md.

phases.phase: MCP server v2.0.0 (14 tools: 9 read, 5 approval-gated write; user context, Dataverse impersonation, input validation, Purview checks, Key Vault secret, correlation logging, tests, Dockerfile, client, deploy, rollback and log scripts)
phases.assumptions: 57 automated tests pass against the fixture backend; Dataverse calls verified against a mock. Not yet run against a live Dataverse environment.

phases.phase: Seed data generator and loader (customers, procedures, contacts, articles, runbooks, technicians, tickets, notes, new incidents, labelled document, business-hours SLA)
phases.assumptions: Deterministic seed; loader verified against a mock Dataverse Web API (all counts match). Volumes and exercise records in setup/DATA-SPEC.md.

phases.phase: Provisioning automation (ARM template, userData bootstrap, logon task, Dataverse schema, app and least-privileged roles, two identities, OAuth connection, agent, Key Vault, readiness check)
phases.assumptions: Static checks pass; first live deployment still to run. The OAuth connection metadata, developer environment creation as the team user and the Tier 1 user's environment access are the riskiest steps.

phases.phase: Governance quartet (ARM policy, custom RBAC, usage policy) and masterdoc
phases.assumptions: Allow-list mirrors deploy-01.json resource types and SKUs.

phases.phase: Lab guide content (getting started, seven exercises with 27 tasks and 104 steps, README, reference solution, data specification)
phases.assumptions: Written to the cloudlabs-step-by-step profile and the TOC v2 schedule; portal labels taken from Microsoft Learn and flagged where the docs are thin.

phases.phase: Validation scripts (14 PowerShellV2 checks) and registration checklist
phases.assumptions: Checks read ARM, AI Search, Log Analytics and Dataverse with the CloudLabs service principal; GUIDs are minted at registration.
Sweden Central retail prices retrieved 2026-10-01; Purview meters and the Microsoft 365 E5 list price checked 2026-10-02.
Captured during the pilot walk-through; getting-started sign-in shots reused from the standard CloudLabs set.

phases.phase: Pilot deployment, end-to-end test and fixes
phases.assumptions: One full walk-through with both identities, plus fixes for the pilot checklist items in setup/README.md (OAuth connection, impersonation errors, Purview latency, portal label drift, log fields).

phases.phase: Platform onboarding (template library, blob uploads, template configuration, second lab user, validation registration, licence assignment)

phases.assumptions: Gateway app registration with the ServiceDesk.Access scope, Purview app, sensitivity label and DLP policy, Purview pay-as-you-go, Power Platform settings, quota check, a Microsoft licensing answer on shared team accounts, and confirming Temporary Access Pass sign-in for attendees plus password sign-in to Power Platform for provisioning in the TAP tenant.

risks.risk: In the TAP tenant, AzureAdUserPassword holds a Temporary Access Pass, so provisioning can't sign the team account in to Power Platform and Dataverse without a browser
risks.impact: Developer environment, schema, security and seed steps fail; Azure Resource Manager steps are unaffected (they run as the provisioning managed identity)
risks.mitigation: Settle before the pilot: a password valid during provisioning, or a Power Platform service principal that creates the environment for the team account (setup/README.md section 1)

risks.risk: Creating a Power Platform developer environment as each team account fails or is restricted in the lab tenant
risks.impact: No Dataverse environment, so no Service Desk app or seed data
risks.mitigation: Pilot first; fallback is an admin-created environment per team with the team account as System Administrator

risks.risk: The Foundry OAuth2 project connection that deploy-01.json creates uses metadata keys that Microsoft doesn't document
risks.impact: The agent can't obtain the technician's token, so every MCP tool call fails
risks.mitigation: Pilot item: compare with a reference connection created by azd ai connection create and align deploy-01.json; confirm whether the redirect URL is per connection or regional

risks.risk: One account per role per team, shared by its members, is judged multiplexing
risks.mitigation: Get written confirmation from Microsoft licensing, or give every attendee their own accounts

risks.risk: The Tier 1 Technician can't sign in to the agent or the Service Desk app with the roles provisioning grants
risks.impact: The Exercise 5 Task 4 comparison between the two identities can't run
risks.mitigation: Pilot item; the readiness check reports the Tier 1 identity as Ready, Not ready or Not configured before the session

risks.risk: Foundry portal labels for adding a knowledge source change before delivery
risks.impact: Participants can't follow Exercise 1 Task 2 as written
risks.mitigation: Fallback script Update-AgentDefinition.ps1 -Knowledge; re-check labels in the pilot

risks.risk: Purview DLP events and Foundry agent traces take several minutes to appear
risks.impact: Exercise 6 evidence arrives after the step that looks for it
risks.mitigation: The guide checks the MCP server's result first and the portals last; Get-ActionTrail.ps1 shows the gateway, server and Dataverse hops first; measure the latency in the pilot

risks.risk: Model quota below 30K TPM per team in Sweden Central
risks.mitigation: Check the quota tier before the event; reduce capacity per team if needed

risks.impact: ACR Tasks paused: provisioning and redeploy exercises fail
